units.source_text: 反而许多乌鸦，不知从那里都聚向这地方。

en.t: Instead, many crows had gathered at this place from who knew where.

units.source_text: 白昼一望，这鸦是不知多少匹的转着圆圈，绕了最高的鸱吻，啼着飞舞。

en.t: In the daytime, one could see countless crows circling, flying and crying around the highest ridge-end ornament.

units.source_text: 一到这门上的天空被夕照映得通红的时候，这便仿佛撒着胡麻似的，尤其看得分明。

en.t: When the sky above the gate turned crimson in the evening light, they looked especially clear, as if sesame seeds had been scattered there.

units.source_text: 不消说，这些乌鸦是因为要喙食那门上的死人的肉而来的了。

en.t: Needless to say, those crows had come to peck at the flesh of the dead bodies on the gate.

units.source_text: ——但在今日，或者因为时刻太晚了罢，却一匹也没有见。

en.t: But today, perhaps because it was too late, not a single one could be seen.

units.source_text: 只见处处将要崩裂的，那裂缝中生出长的野草的石阶上面，老鸦粪粘得点点的发白。

en.t: All that could be seen was old crow droppings clinging in white specks to the stone steps, which were cracking everywhere and sprouting long weeds from their fissures.

units.source_text: 家将将那洗旧的红青袄子的臀部，坐在七级阶的最上级，

en.t: The servant set the seat of his washed-out reddish-blue lined robe on the top of the seven steps,

units.source_text: 恼着那右颊上发出来的一颗大的面疱，惘惘然的看着雨下。

en.t: troubled by a large pimple that had appeared on his right cheek, and stared vacantly at the falling rain.
